visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and glasses, wearing a black formal suit, white shirt, and black tie, stands in front of a white curtain background. He holds a black microphone and speaks with high energy, looking directly at the camera with exaggerated facial expressions. Yellow variety-show style text appears at the bottom. (2) The scene transitions to a split-screen debate. On the left, the same man wears a dark olive green hoodie and a black beanie; on the right, he wears a blue denim jacket over a white t-shirt. Both characters sit at a wooden table with microphones, engaging in a heated argument with animated hand gestures and intense eye contact. (3) During the debate, the character in the green hoodie performs a magic trick with a black top hat, producing a CGI white pigeon and white smoke. The character in the denim jacket responds with a skeptical and frustrated facial expression. The lighting is bright and even across the indoor studio environment. (4) The man in the black suit returns to the frame, holding a modern smartphone close to the camera lens. The phone screen displays the LINE messaging interface with a prominent distorted face profile picture. He points at the screen while continuing his energetic delivery. The video ends with a full-screen graphic featuring an illustration and brand logos.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously highlight the generational divide and social etiquette regarding voice calls versus messaging on LINE, ultimately promoting LINE MUSIC's new personalized ringtone feature.
